item.title: Cost‑saving techniques cut LLM spend for agentic AI workflows
item.description:
Cost‑saving techniques cut LLM spend for agentic AI workflows

ProjectDiscovery applied this to their security testing agent Neo in April 2026. The result was a 59 percent reduction in LLM costs within the first few days, reaching 70 percent by day ten.

🔍 Overview

  • “An agent runs a loop: it reasons, calls a tool, reads the result, updates its plan, and repeats.”
  • “Every iteration carries the full conversation history forward.”
  • “By step five of a ten-step task, the model is reading everything that came before it on every single call.”
  • “Context length grows with each step, and cost scales with context length.”

📊 Cost Challenge

  • “According to research from Antino and Zylos, LLM API calls account for 70 to 85 percent of total agentic AI cost, and agents make three to ten times more LLM calls than simple chatbots.”
  • “Unoptimized production agents regularly reach $10 to $100 per session in API spend.”
  • “That ceiling matters because 88 percent of organisations are experimenting with agents, but only 23 percent are actively scaling, and Gartner projects 40 percent of agentic AI projects will be cancelled by 2027.”

📏 Measuring First

  • “You cannot optimise what you have not measured.”
  • “Instrument every LLM call before you write a single optimisation.”
  • “Record input tokens, output tokens, model name, task type, and step number.”
  • “Aggregate by task run, not by request, so you can see the full cost of one unit of work.”
  • “If your cost‑per‑task spikes after step three, that tells you the context is accumulating faster than the task is progressing, which points directly at context compaction as the right fix.”
  • “Store these records somewhere you can query them by task type.”
  • “After one week of load testing, you will have a cost distribution per task type that you can use to set per‑task budgets and to forecast monthly spend at your target volume.”

💾 Prompt Caching

  • “If your system prompt is long, your agent pays full price for it on every call.”
  • “Prompt caching lets the model provider store the computed representation of a static prefix and charge a fraction of the normal input rate for subsequent calls that reuse it.”
  • “The technique requires that the cacheable content sits at the start of the prompt and stays stable across calls, so structure your prompts with the static system instructions first and the variable task context after.”
  • “One developer account dropped from $720 per month to $72.”

🧩 Model Routing

  • “Not every step in an agentic workflow needs a frontier model.”
  • “Planning and synthesis benefit from the best reasoning available.”
  • “Classification, intent detection, filtering, and repeated sub‑tasks often produce equally reliable results from a model that costs a tenth as much.”
  • “Build a routing layer that maps task types to model tiers.”
  • “The decision criterion is whether the step requires open‑ended reasoning or whether it fits inside a well‑defined scope where a smaller model can be reliable.”
  • “Test each route with representative inputs before you trust it in production.”

🛠️ Context Summarisation

  • “The most direct attack on the quadratic growth problem is to stop the context from growing unchecked.”
  • “At each step, summarise completed sub‑tasks into a compact record and drop the raw turn history.”
  • “This requires a small summarisation call, which adds a modest cost at each checkpoint, but that cost is fixed per step rather than proportional to total history length.”
  • “For tasks beyond five or six steps, compaction almost always pays for itself.”

#LLM #AgenticAI #PromptCaching #CostOptimization

Source: Agent Token Economics: Engineering Cost Efficiency Before Your First Production Deployment — Agentic Ready

item.title: 🌊 Navigate the FinOps Wave: Your Ultimate Guide to AWS at FinOps X 2025
item.description:
🌊 Navigate the FinOps Wave: Your Ultimate Guide to AWS at FinOps X 2025

📌 Summary

Mark your calendars for an unmissable opportunity! This guide walks you through all the exciting AWS activities at FinOps X 2025 in San Diego (June 2-5). From executive keynotes to hands-on optimization workshops and exclusive networking events, discover how to maximize your conference experience while connecting with AWS experts to elevate your cloud financial management journey.

🎯 Why FinOps X 2025 Matters for AWS Users

The convergence of cloud financial management and technological innovation has never been more critical than now. As organizations worldwide grapple with optimizing their cloud spend while maximizing value, FinOps X 2025 emerges as the premier gathering for practitioners seeking to master this balance.

If you’re leveraging AWS and want to enhance your cloud financial management strategy, this year’s conference in San Diego (June 2-5) offers unique opportunities to connect directly with AWS teams, discover cutting-edge optimization techniques, and network with industry leaders who’ve successfully navigated similar challenges.

📸 Imagine the San Diego waterfront setting where cloud financial experts will gather next month

🗓️ Your Day-by-Day AWS Experience Planner

𝗗𝗮𝘆 𝟬: 𝗠𝗼𝗻𝗱𝗮𝘆, 𝗝𝘂𝗻𝗲 𝟮

Start your conference journey with two essential touchpoints:

  • AWS Booth Experience (4:00PM – 7:00PM) Connect with the OPTICS team and Cloud Financial Management experts to discuss your specific challenges and learn about the latest developments.

  • 🍹 AWS Reception Party (6:30-8:30PM, Coronado Terrace) Network in style at this exclusive social mixer! Enjoy refreshments and meaningful conversations with AWS team members and fellow FinOps leaders in a relaxed atmosphere. This is your chance to establish connections before the formal sessions begin.

Pro tip: Don’t forget to RSVP for the reception to secure your spot!

𝗗𝗮𝘆 𝟭: 𝗧𝘂𝗲𝘀𝗱𝗮𝘆, 𝗝𝘂𝗻𝗲 𝟯

Your day begins with industry-leading insights:

  • Leadership Keynote (8:00-9:30AM, Keynote Stage) Don’t miss James Greenfield, VP of AWS Commerce Platform, participating in a high-level panel discussion with cloud industry leaders.

  • 𝙎𝙩𝙖𝙣𝙙𝙤𝙪𝙩 𝙎𝙚𝙨𝙨𝙞𝙤𝙣𝙨:

    1. Lockheed Martin’s 30% Cost Savings Story (11:00-11:45AM) Learn how this aerospace giant achieved remarkable cost efficiency through advanced FinOps practices.

    2. 🔥 The Frugality Fest Workshop (1:00-3:00PM) Form a team and compete in real-time cost optimization challenges! Bring your laptop for this hands-on experience with a pre-populated AWS account.

    3. Adapting FinOps for Generative AI (4:15-5:00PM) Discover how traditional CFM practices can be leveraged while addressing the unique cost considerations of GenAI workloads.

𝗗𝗮𝘆 𝟮: 𝗪𝗲𝗱𝗻𝗲𝘀𝗱𝗮𝘆, 𝗝𝘂𝗻𝗲 𝟰

The innovation continues:

  • Leadership Keynote (8:00-9:30AM, Keynote Stage) John Phillips, Director of AWS Insights and Optimization, will unveil exciting new announcements you won’t want to miss.

  • 𝙏𝙚𝙘𝙝𝙣𝙞𝙘𝙖𝙡 𝙄𝙢𝙢𝙚𝙧𝙨𝙞𝙤𝙣:

    1. What’s New in Cost Optimization (11:00-11:45AM) Get the latest on AWS cost optimization capabilities for monitoring performance, costs, and receiving actionable recommendations.

    2. 🧮 Advanced CUR Analytics (1:00-2:00PM) Master the art of querying AWS Cost and Usage Reports for deeper insights into service usage and optimization opportunities.

    3. New AWS FinOps Tools Revealed (4:15-5:00PM) Explore recent enhancements designed to transform cost analysis workflows, improve estimation accuracy, and strengthen governance.

📸 Visualize the AWS Stage room where these in-depth technical sessions will take place

🤝 Make Meaningful Connections

Beyond scheduled sessions, FinOps X 2025 offers valuable opportunities for personalized engagement:

  • One-on-One Meetings: Connect with AWS Cloud Financial Management product leaders to discuss your specific challenges and provide direct feedback that shapes future offerings.

  • AWS Booth Consultations: Available throughout Tuesday and Wednesday (7:00AM – 5:00PM), the booth serves as your hub for impromptu discussions with AWS experts who love “getting nerdy about FinOps.”

  • Group Discussions: Coordinate with your account team to join focused conversations around particular aspects of cloud financial management.

🚀 Why This Matters: Beyond Just Another Conference

FinOps X 2025 represents more than just technical sessions—it’s a strategic opportunity to reshape your organization’s approach to cloud economics. With AWS showcasing new tools while featuring customer success stories like Lockheed Martin’s impressive 30% savings implementation, attendees gain practical frameworks they can apply immediately.

The emphasis on hands-on experiences—particularly the Frugality Fest Workshop—demonstrates AWS’s commitment to practical skill development rather than theoretical concepts alone. Additionally, the forward-looking sessions on Generative AI cost management highlight how FinOps practices must evolve alongside emerging technologies.

For organizations struggling to balance innovation with fiscal responsibility, these sessions provide the ideal blend of strategic vision and tactical implementation guidance from those who’ve successfully navigated these waters.

💭 Final Thoughts: Maximizing Your FinOps X Investment

The convergence of financial and technical expertise represented at FinOps X 2025 creates a unique learning environment. By strategically planning your schedule to include AWS keynotes, practical workshops, and networking opportunities, you position yourself to bring transformative insights back to your organization.

As cloud technologies continue evolving at breakneck speeds, will your organization’s financial governance keep pace? FinOps X 2025 might just provide the blueprint you need.
